 Brianna Sainez Fri, November 13, 2026 at 4:27 p.m. UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. She's a mom! Avril Lavigne surprised fans with news that she secretly welcomed her first child.
 "Our Mini F-- Princess has arrived 🎀👑🍼🩷," Lavigne, 42, captioned a carousel of photos shared via Instagram on Friday, November 13.
 Avril Lavigne Secretly Welcomes Baby No. 1
 Avril Lavigne announced that she welcomed her first child on November 13. BY: MEGA
 Though she didn't reveal the baby's father, one photo showed two large hands embracing the infant's tiny hand, while another featured three pairs of checkered Vans sneakers resting on a skateboard.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement A final photo showed the "Complicated" singer embracing her daughter, who was wearing an adorable cheetah-print onesie.
 View this post on Instagram 
 Lavigne's last public appearance dates back to April, when she was seen leaving the Chateau Marmont Hotel in Los Angeles after partying with friends.
 Multiple publications reported that she made another appearance months later in July, performing at Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's New York City wedding.
